narrative.narrative: The 24-hour intake of dollars held on Binance, excluding the venue's own token, rose to 116.2 million dollars from 59.3 million dollars, which means more dollars arrived on the largest venue where holders can sell. Across trading venues, the same measure was a 123.0 million dollar net outflow, 0.0452 percent of custodied value, compared with a 177.8 million dollar outflow and 0.0652 percent on the prior print, which means dollars are still leaving venues overall, but by less than the prior print. Bitfinex sent out 58.3 million dollars, compared with 64.5 million dollars, and Bitstamp sent out 64.0 million dollars.
